title: Core: align/distribute objects
description: Implement Modify > Align panel operations in packages/core/src/engine/align.ts. Functions: alignLeft, alignRight, alignTop, alignBottom, alignHCenter, alignVCenter (align to each other or to stage), distributeHorizontal, distributeVertical (equal spacing). All take (doc, sceneIdx, layerIdx, frameIdx, objectIds[], alignToStage: boolean). Return new FlashDocument. Add unit tests in packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/align.test.ts. Export from packages/core/src/engine/index.ts.
